measures.label: Residents
measures.desc: People counted in 2021.

measures.label: People per km²
measures.desc: Residents per square kilometre of land.

measures.label: Median age
measures.desc: Half the residents are older than this.

measures.label: Children 0–14
measures.desc: Share of residents aged 14 and under.

measures.label: Young adults 20–34
measures.desc: Share of residents aged 20 to 34.

measures.label: Seniors 65 and over
measures.desc: Share of residents aged 65 and over.

measures.label: Average household size
measures.desc: People per household.

measures.label: People living alone
measures.desc: Share of households with one person.

measures.label: Couples with children
measures.desc: Share of households that are a couple with children.

measures.label: One-parent families
measures.desc: Share of households that are one-parent families.

measures.label: Moved in the last 5 years
measures.desc: Share of residents who lived at another address in 2016.

measures.label: Immigrants
measures.desc: Share of residents born outside Canada who have settled here.

measures.label: Recent immigrants
measures.desc: Share of residents who immigrated between 2016 and 2021.

measures.label: Visible minority
measures.desc: Share of residents who belong to a visible minority, as defined by the Employment Equity Act.

measures.label: Mother tongue not English or French
measures.desc: Share of residents whose first language learned is neither official language.

measures.label: University degree
measures.desc: Share of 25 to 64 year olds with a bachelor's degree or higher.

measures.label: No diploma
measures.desc: Share of 25 to 64 year olds with no certificate, diploma or degree.

measures.label: Unemployment rate
measures.desc: Share of the labour force out of work in May 2021.

measures.label: Labour force participation
measures.desc: Share of people 15 and over working or looking for work.

measures.label: Worked from home
measures.desc: Share of employed people who worked at home in May 2021, during the pandemic.

measures.label: Work outside Guelph
measures.desc: Share of commuters with a usual workplace outside the city.

measures.label: Median household income
measures.desc: Total household income in 2020, before tax.

measures.label: Median after-tax household income
measures.desc: Household income in 2020, after tax.

measures.label: Median individual income
measures.desc: Total income in 2020 of people 15 and over who had income.

measures.label: Low income (LIM-AT)
measures.desc: Share of residents below the low-income measure, after tax.

measures.label: Households that rent
measures.desc: Share of households renting their home.

measures.label: Single-detached houses
measures.desc: Share of homes that are single-detached houses.

measures.label: Apartments 5+ storeys
measures.desc: Share of homes in apartment buildings of five or more storeys.

measures.label: Condominiums
measures.desc: Share of homes that are condominiums.

measures.label: Homes built before 1961
measures.desc: Share of homes built in 1960 or earlier.

measures.label: Homes built since 2001
measures.desc: Share of homes built from 2001 to 2021.

measures.label: Median home value
measures.desc: Owners' estimate of what their home would sell for, 2021.

measures.label: Median monthly rent
measures.desc: Median monthly shelter cost for renters, 2021.

measures.label: Paying 30%+ on housing
measures.desc: Share of households spending 30% or more of income on shelter.

measures.desc: Share of households in core housing need: housing that costs too much, is too small or needs major repairs, with no affordable local alternative.

measures.label: Crowded homes
measures.desc: Share of households in homes without enough bedrooms (not suitable).

measures.desc: Share of commuters who drive or ride in a car, truck or van.

measures.desc: Share of commuters who take the bus or train.

measures.label: Commute on foot or by bike
measures.desc: Share of commuters who walk or cycle.

measures.desc: Average 15-Minute Guelph score (0–100) of the addresses inside. The city figure is the average resident's score.
